high_level_description: The image depicts a large, outdoor sculpture titled "Triumph of Labour," located on a circular stone pedestal. The sculpture is made of bronze or a similar metal and features several figures engaged in laborious tasks. The central figure appears to be lifting or carrying a heavy load, while others assist or support the effort. The figures are dynamic, with some leaning forward and others standing upright, conveying a sense of teamwork and struggle. The pedestal is made of reddish-brown stone blocks and has an inscription at its base. The text reads: "TRIUMPH OF LABOUR BY DEVI PRASAD ROY CHAUD
